units.english: Merchants near <system>
units.italian: Mercanti vicino a <system>

units.english: A merchant fleet has been spotted in Southern space. Join in destroying them and return to <planet> in the <system> system by <day> for a cut of the loot (<payment>).
units.italian: Una flotta mercantile è stata avvistata in spazio meridionale. Unisciti allo scontro per distruggerla e torna su <planet>, nel sistema <system>, entro <day> per una parte del bottino (<payment>).

units.english: The merchants have been eliminated. Return to <destination> for your cut of the loot.
units.italian: I mercanti sono stati eliminati. Torna su <destination> per la tua parte del bottino.

units.english: After counting up the loot from the destroyed merchant fleet, you are given your cut. <payment>
units.italian: Dopo aver contato il bottino della flotta mercantile distrutta, ti viene data la tua parte. <payment>

units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.english: Local Navy forces are attacking <destination>! Defeat them to defend anarchy!
units.italian: Forze della Marina locale stanno attaccando <destination>! Sconfiggile per difendere l'anarchia!

units.english: The Navy fleets have been defeated. Return to <destination>.
units.italian: Le flotte della Marina sono state sconfitte. Torna su <destination>.

units.english: Many locals of <planet> thank you and collectively pay you <payment> for helping to drive off the Navy.
units.italian: Molti abitanti di <planet> ti ringraziano e ti pagano collettivamente <payment> per aver contribuito a respingere la Marina.

units.id: conversation:northern pirate defense|Suddenly you hear raised voices and shouting outside: "We are under attack! <planet> is under attack by the Navy! We need every combat-worthy ship to join the defenses!" This could be an easy way to get yourself killed, and you can't even guarantee that you will be paid for your work.|3056|0
units.english: Suddenly you hear raised voices and shouting outside: "We are under attack! <planet> is under attack by the Navy! We need every combat-worthy ship to join the defenses!" This could be an easy way to get yourself killed, and you can't even guarantee that you will be paid for your work.
units.italian: All'improvviso senti voci concitate e grida fuori: "Siamo sotto attacco! <planet> è sotto attacco della Marina! Ci serve ogni nave in grado di combattere per le difese!" Potrebbe essere un modo facile per farti uccidere, e non hai nemmeno la garanzia di essere pagato per il tuo lavoro.

units.id: conversation:northern pirate defense|	(Stay here until the fight is over.)|3058|0
units.english: (Stay here until the fight is over.)
units.italian: (Resta qui finché la battaglia non è finita.)

units.id: conversation:northern pirate defense|	(Join the defense fleet.)|3060|0
units.english: (Join the defense fleet.)
units.italian: (Unisciti alla flotta di difesa.)

units.id: conversation:northern pirate defense|	Local pirate forces are preparing to repel the Navy attack. You join them, and take off together...|3061|0
units.english: Local pirate forces are preparing to repel the Navy attack. You join them, and take off together...
units.italian: Le forze piratesche locali si preparano a respingere l'attacco della Marina. Ti unisci a loro e decollate insieme...
